sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seuratM)
#Set seed to ensure reproducibility
seed <- 1234
bp <- MulticoreParam(3, RNGseed=1234)
sce <- scDblFinder(sce, samples = "Sample", BPPARAM = bp)
table(sce$scDblFinder.class)
## 
## singlet doublet 
##  194789   13952
#add column to metadata
meta_scdblfinder <- sce@colData@listData%>% as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("scDblFinder"))%>%
  dplyr::select(scDblFinder.class, scDblFinder.score)
rownames(meta_scdblfinder) <- sce@colData@rownames

seuratM <- AddMetaData(seuratM, metadata = meta_scdblfinder)


# Summarize doublet proportions by cluster
doublet_summary <- seuratM@meta.data %>%
  group_by(clusterName) %>%
  summarize(
    total_cells = n(),
    n_doublets = sum(scDblFinder.class == "doublet"),
    prop_doublets = n_doublets / total_cells
  )

doublet_summary

#Identify clusters by proportion of doublets
# Over 85% doublets
high_doublet_clusters <- doublet_summary %>%
  filter(prop_doublets > 0.85) %>%
  pull(clusterName)

# 50-85% doublets
mid_doublet_clusters <- doublet_summary %>%
  filter(prop_doublets > 0.50, prop_doublets <= 0.85) %>%
  pull(clusterName)

Clusters with high burden of doublets:
8 83%.
9 78%.
12 62%.
14 85%

# Define which cells to keep
meta <- seuratM@meta.data
meta$keep <- !(
  # Remove whole cluster from >85% doublet clusters
  (meta$clusterName %in% high_doublet_clusters) |
  # Remove only doublets from 50–85% doublet clusters
  ((meta$clusterName %in% mid_doublet_clusters) & (meta$scDblFinder.class == "doublet")) 
)

# Step 4: Subset Seurat object to keep only desired cells
seuratM_filtered <- subset(seuratM, cells = rownames(meta[meta$keep, ]))

#Summary of filtered cells
cat("Cells before filtering:", nrow(meta), "\n")

cat("Cells after filtering:", ncol(seuratM_filtered), "\n")

selGenes <- data.frame(geneID = rev(c("TTN", "MYBPC3", "RYR2", "NEBL", "TNNT2", "CMYA5", "COL6A3", "DCN",  "FBN1", "C7", "PDGFRA", "CDH19", "PDGFRB","ITGA7","RGS5", "NOTCH3", "MYH11", "ACTA2","CNN1", "LMOD1", "MYL9" ,"PECAM1", "VWF", "EGFL7", "POSTN", "ITGA10", "CDH11","CCL21", "PROX1", "FLT4", "NRXN1", "ANK3", "PTPRZ1", "ASIC2", "PIEZO2", "MTHFD1L", "ACACB", "PLIN1", "GPAM", "CD163", "MRC1", "SIGLEC1", "STAB1", "CSF1R", "MERTK", "IL7R", "PTPRC", "CD2", "KIT", "CPA3", "IL18R1", "MS4A1", "PAX5", "FCRL5","IGKC"))) %>%
